title: Mentoring a lab colleague? Share your ‘CV of failures’ with them
title_zh: 辅导实验室同事？与他们分享你的“失败简历”
abstract: Melanie Stefan became a ‘poster child of failure’ after writing an article about it. Now she urges senior colleagues to be more open about career setbacks.
abstract_zh: 梅拉妮·斯特凡在撰写关于失败的文章后成为“失败的代言人”。现在她敦促资深同事更加坦诚地谈论职业生涯中的挫折。
snippet: Melanie Stefan became a ‘poster child of failure’ after writing an article about it. Now she urges senior colleagues to be more open about career setbacks.
